ingredients.recipe_text: ½ cup meat stock or water (or just enough to make a stiff dough)
ingredients.basis: 1/2 cup water × USDA 237 g per 8 fl oz

ingredients.recipe_text: 2 Tbsp. lard or bacon grease, melted

notes: Shape the batch into 4 equal cakes; one cake is one serving.
Uses whole-grain yellow cornmeal, water and lard. Optional salt is excluded.
Includes all cooking fat, although some may remain in the pan. Stock, bacon grease and added salt change these values. Finished cake weight has not been measured.
